correctness.rationale: For every r>=3,L>=1 the graph-geodesic face criterion partitions the complex into a join of r discrete L-point sets plus internal and central edges. Arm-permutation quotient of the join is homeomorphic to a sorted weighted-depth chamber; explicit coordinate homotopy merges repeated depths and fixes a simplex (r-1)-skeleton. The skeleton toggling-vertex acyclic matching leaves exactly C(L-1,r) (r-1)-cells and one vertex, establishing its complete integral homotopy. Added edge orbits contribute C(L,2)+L-1 circles. The proof reconstructs all quantifiers including L<=r, and gives a free fundamental group and no integral torsion. Direct independent geodesic enumeration, barycentric orbit cellular chains, integer boundary-square tests and exact ranks modulo 2,3,5,7 pass for all 10 profiles r=3,4 and L=1,...,5; those finite checks corroborate but do not replace the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The exact ordinary geometric quotient of a natural infinite equal-arm spider family had known rational Betti numbers but no determined integral torsion, fundamental group or actual homotopy type. Quotient torsion is a genuine possible obstruction that rational transfer cannot exclude. This strong deformation retraction resolves it, shows all homology integrally free, gives the full free group pi_1, and proves a sharp high-dimensional sphere onset L=r+1, including nontrivial examples (r,L)=(3,4),(4,5). A complete integral quotient classification is natural and mathematically informative beyond a rank recalculation.
